'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[Iran]] claims to have blacklisted 45 tankers in the [[Strait of Hormuz]] that breached its rules for crossing the waterway, with the [[Persian Gulf Strait Authority]] threatening fines, detainments, and confiscations against the named vessels. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-warns-vessels-violating-hormuz-transit-rules-fines-detention-2026-08-24/ (Reuters)]
****The [[Islamic Consultative Assembly|Iran parliament]]'s [[Commission on National Security and Foreign Policy|National Security and Foreign Policy Commission]] approves a draft allowing Iran to charge ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/iranian-parliamentary-committee-approves-provision-charge-ships-hormuz (Middle East Eye)]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
****Two [[Israel|Israeli]] [[airstrike|airstrikes]] kill two people, including a four-year-old boy, in the [[Gaza Strip]] in violation of the [[Gaza peace plan|October 2025]] [[ceasefire]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/israeli-airstrikes-gaza-kill-two-people-including-4-year-old-boy-medics-say-2026-08-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Controversies of Hassan Sheikh Mohamud]]
***At least ten people are killed and several others injured in clashes between [[Somali Armed Forces|federal forces]] and residents protesting a controversial demolition and forced eviction in [[Yaqshid, Mogadishu|Yaaqshid neighbourhood]] of [[Mogadishu]]. [https://www.ftlsomalia.com/violence-erupts-in-mogadishu-as-residents-protest-demolition-of-homes-in-tookiyo-neighbourhood/ (FTL Somalia)] [https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/somalia-heavy-weapons-reported-used-during-mogadishu-evictions-as-turkish-f-16s-fly-over-capital (''Garowe Online'')] [https://shabellemedia.com/mogadishu-protests-turn-violent-as-residents-resist-home-demolitions/ (Shabelle Media)]
**The [[Turkish Armed Forces]] carries out an [[airstrike]] in [[Garmaal]], [[Puntland]], killing at least four people, in response to the previous [[Piracy|hijacking]] of a [[Cameroon]]-flagged [[Watercraft|vessel]] by [[Piracy off the coast of Somalia|Somali pirates]], which was transporting military equipment to the [[Camp TURKSOM]] in [[Mogadishu]]. The [[Puntland Security Force|authorities of Puntland]] identified the victims as civilian [[Fisherman|fishermen]]. [https://www.somaliguardian.com/news/somalia-news/somalia-defends-turkish-drone-strike-puntland-civilians/ (Somali Guardian)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 campaign (2022–present)|M23 campaign]]
***The [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] and the [[March 23 Movement|M23]] rebel group agree on a roadmap for further peace negotiations under the [[2025 DRC–Rwanda peace agreement|Doha Framework Agreement]] after talks in [[Switzerland]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/dr-congo-m23-fighters-agree-roadmap-for-peace-talks-joint-statement/article71381809.ece (AFP via ''The Hindu'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Sudan]]'s [[Ministry of Defence (Sudan)|defence ministry]] says that the country's [[Sudanese Armed Forces|armed forces]] (SAF) have shot down a "hostile" drone from [[Ethiopia]] entering its airspace, which was seen flying over the [[Blue Nile State|Blue Nile]] region. [https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/663972/world/sudan-says-it-shot-down-hostile-drone-launched-from-ethiopia (''Saudi Gazette'')] [https://sudanhorizon.com/saf-shoots-down-drone-entering-sudanese-airspace-from-ethiopia/ (''Sudan Horizon'')]
**The SAF-allied [[Darfur Joint Protection Force|Joint Forces]] says that they have destroyed a [[Rapid Support Forces]] convoy in the northern desert [[Libya–Sudan border|bordering]] [[Libya]], along with capturing several vehicles and drone equipment. [https://sudantribune.com/article/317787 (''Sudan Tribune'')]
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**At least 47 people are killed and over 50 others are kidnapped by [[Gangs in Haiti|armed gangs]] in [[Kenscoff]], [[Ouest (department)|Ouest department]], [[Haiti]], in one of the largest mass kidnappings in the conflict. [https://apnews.com/article/haiti-kenscoff-gangs-killed-kidnapped-attack-1690b1523421eb72aa260d9d56b5d521 (AP)]
*[[Mali War]]
**The [[Tuareg people|Tuareg]]-led [[Azawad Liberation Front]] releases 22 [[Mali]]an [[Malian Armed Forces|soldiers]], some held for more than three years, in exchange for at least eight of its fighters and several civilian detainees. [https://macaubusiness.com/tuareg-rebels-release-22-mali-soldiers-security-sources/ (AFP via ''Macau Business'')]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Iván Manjarrez, a [[La Línea (gang)|La Línea]] ringleader accused of controlling [[illegal logging]] in the Chihuahua Mountains, is killed during a security operation in [[Bocoyna Municipality]], [[Chihuahua (state)|Chihuahua]], [[Mexico]]. [https://oem.com.mx/elheraldodechihuahua/local/abaten-al-lider-criminal-el-19-tras-enfrentamiento-en-san-juanito-31706703 (''El Heraldo de Chihuahua'' <small>in Spanish</small>)]
